peripheral.task_subtask: Cross-lingual and cross-modal retrieval of ukiyo-e records

peripheral.evidence_location: Table 1, p. 5; p. 6; Table 5, p. 10; Sec. 6, p. 11
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: the authors treat these as CKG construction sub-tasks, but the datasets contain no graph structure and the tasks produce no triples; recorded as peripheral. SS: subsets sampled for balance (Table 5).

peripheral.documented_use: Training and testing: node classification accuracy, clustering NMI/ARI and 10-fold graph classification accuracy of HCL vs supervised and unsupervised baselines.
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: homogeneous graphs without KG semantics; recorded as peripheral.
peripheral.dataset_families: Planetoid citation graphs; Amazon/Coauthor graphs; TU graph classification datasets

peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: heterogeneous information networks rather than KGs with an ontology; recorded as peripheral.

peripheral.task_subtask: Voice activity detection and speaker diarisation for the audio pipeline

peripheral.task_subtask: Domain-specific code generation in an industrial setting (truck CAN signal read/write)
peripheral.dataset_version: Truck CAN Signal dataset (776 CAN signals in six functional domains; manufacturer's internal CAN documentation; engineer-written test functions)

peripheral.evidence_location: Sec. 5.1, p. 5; Table 2, p. 7; Table 4, p. 8 (PDF pages)
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: the ablation reports a '+KG' setting, but how a KG is built from the internal CAN documentation is not described in the extracted text, so the KG component is unverified; recorded as peripheral pending that check. DL: proprietary data, not released.

peripheral.task_subtask: Multi-hop reasoning over text (retrieval-augmented)
peripheral.dataset_version: HotpotQA (about 100,000 questions; bridge and comparison types) and MuSiQue (25,000 two- to four-hop questions)

peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: no KG for these text benchmarks is described in the extracted text; recorded as peripheral. SS: improvements not significant on the Comparison sub-dataset (p. 20). RI: these baselines are cited as [174]-[177] although the reference list has 47 entries, and the text elsewhere says 'this chapter', suggesting text carried over from a longer work; the citations cannot be resolved.

peripheral.documented_use: Testing: F1 and AUC of active learning with and without correspondence-graph signals vs baselines; augmented training data analysis.
peripheral.evidence_location: Sec. 5.1 and Table 1, pp. 190-192; Table 2, p. 195; Table 3, p. 197
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: SS: relational record pairs; RDF links are mentioned only as a motivation (p. 184), so no KG is used. SS: consolidated row (five tasks).
peripheral.dataset_families: MusicBrainz; WDC Product Corpus; Magellan Restaurants

peripheral.documented_use: Testing: Pertinence, Answer Span and Self-Containment of top quotes from the adaptive web retriever vs WebGLM retriever.
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: no KG component; the text and the Table 3 caption give different query counts.

peripheral.task_subtask: Answer-composer fine-tuning
peripheral.dataset_version: WebGLM-QA (questions, reference passages, grounded answers)

peripheral.limitations_and_scope: RI: no KG component.

peripheral.documented_use: Testing (transfer): Qwen2.5 and Qwen2.5-VL variants with and without scene priors compared on public benchmarks that carry no KG.

peripheral.task_subtask: Open intent discovery (clustering of user utterances into intents)
peripheral.dataset_version: Banking77_eng (77 intents, over 10,000 banking questions) and Banking77_vni (Google-Translate Vietnamese version)

peripheral.documented_use: Validation: number of clusters and extracted intents for BERTopic (73 and 65 intents) vs the OED framework on Banking77_vni (76 intents), against 77 predefined categories.

peripheral.task_subtask: Artwork instance retrieval and image-based metadata suggestion
peripheral.dataset_version: MET dataset (artwork instance retrieval; train split as database, validation and test splits as queries)
peripheral.supporting_paper: Blanco et al. ArtKB: A Multimodal Art Knowledge Base for Cultural Heritage (2026). ESWC 2026 (Resources track), Proc. Part II, LNCS 16550, pp. 58-75. DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-25159-6_4
peripheral.documented_use: Training and testing: SwinV2 trained with supervised contrastive learning (Accuracy@1 66.1, Accuracy@3 72.5, mAP 50.9 on the test split); metadata suggestion by similarity-weighted voting over the top 10 neighbours evaluated with Recall@1/@5 for classification, culture, artist, medium and tags.
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: DL: attribute values in MET are heterogeneous, long-tailed and poorly harmonised (p. 71). SS: queries with missing ground truth for an attribute are excluded; support reported per attribute (p. 71). RI: the evaluation uses MET metadata directly; the ArtKB graph is not queried, so this row is peripheral although the deployed service retrieves metadata from the KG.

peripheral.task_subtask: Vision-language benchmark evaluation of KG-tuned models
peripheral.dataset_version: MMMU, MME (reasoning), DocVQA, ChartQA (human), A-OKVQA
peripheral.supporting_paper: Shbita, Li & Gentile. Context-Aware Visual Multi-turn Conversation Generation from Wikipedia and Wikidata (2026). ESWC 2026 (In-Use track), Proc. Part II, LNCS 16550, pp. 360-377. DOI 10.1007/978-3-032-25159-6_19
peripheral.documented_use: Testing: baseline and six tuned variants of Granite-Vision-3.3 and SmolVLM scored as stress tests of transfer; LoRA largely preserves scores while full fine-tuning degrades MMMU, A-OKVQA and DocVQA; category-wise MMMU changes reported.
peripheral.limitations_and_scope: SS: benchmarks are used as stress tests rather than targets; the domain and format mismatch with the generated data is acknowledged (p. 372). SS: Wikidata's domain distribution may shift performance, e.g., degradation in finance-related categories (p. 373). RI: the text attributes the best Granite MME to LoRA+CLIP70k and LoRA70k, but Table 2 gives 353.9 for LoRA 70k and 320.0 for LoRA+CLIP 70k, and the highest Granite ChartQA (95.20) is LoRA+CLIP 35k.
